result.title: From Proposal to Execution: Modeling Interaction Semantics in Shared Autonomy
result.summary: In many human-AI systems, candidate actions are not executed directly but are first evaluated by another decision-making entity under a potentially different objective or decision model. Standard decision-theoretic frameworks do not require this interaction to be represented explicitly, as they define transition dynamics directly over state-action pairs, allowing evaluation to be absorbed within the transition model. We introduce a semantics-aware decision framework in which a candidate action is proposed, evaluated under an interaction context, and then resolved into an executed outcome. We formalize this through a joint action language and an interpretation function that maps each joint action and context to a semantic outcome. Transition and reward dynamics are induced through these semantic outcomes, thereby introducing an explicit representational layer for \textit{interaction semantics}. Semantic outcomes provide explicit units for organizing interaction principles, which can be instantiated through application-specific evaluation mechanisms and reused across distinct interaction instances. This provides a structured interface for specifying context-dependent evaluation separately from the resulting execution dynamics, without requiring changes to the underlying planning algorithm. We instantiate the framework in shared human-AI autonomy, capturing interaction patterns such as advisory and authorization, and illustrating how interaction context influences decision making. The resulting formulation remains compatible with standard Markov decision process (MDP) planning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一个语义感知决策框架，把候选动作的「提出—在交互语境下评估—解析为执行结果」显式区分开，用联合动作语言与解释函数将交互语义建模为独立表示层，并以共享人机自主中的咨询、授权等模式作实例，保持与标准 MDP 规划兼容。
AI.relevance_reason: 该框架把「提议—评估—执行」拆成可复用的显式语义结果单元，可能与 LVR 中候选 latent 推理步骤的生成、验证与停止/采纳决策存在结构类比，其「评估机制与执行动力学解耦」的思路可供核查能否用于组织 latent 假设与视觉证据筛选。
